about: The list behind checklist.html. Threads and people edit it in a pull request: add a pull request when it is ready for the owner, remove lines once they are done. Public repos only; nothing private goes here.

sections.title: Repo settings
sections.intro: Settings only the owner can change. GitHub's settings pages open in Safari on an iPad (ask for the desktop site); the GitHub app can't change them.

items.note: The landing zone's workflows read Azure and Entra IDs from Actions secrets, so a run can't print them in a public log.

items.text: After that merge: any landing zone ID kept as an Actions variable (repo or environment) is recreated as a secret, and the variable deleted. You type the values; they never go in a chat.
Secret scanning and push protection on for every repo: org Code security, Configurations, GitHub recommended, apply to all repositories.
Private vulnerability reporting on, so the Security tab offers Report a vulnerability.
A default-branch ruleset: restrict deletions, block force pushes, require a pull request. Export avd-second-brain's and import it.
Actions, General, in each repo: fork pull requests from external contributors need approval, and the default workflow token only reads.
Keep my email address private, and block command line pushes that expose it.

sections.title: Merge in this order
sections.intro: Ready from GitHub mobile once a line says Ready to merge. A line with two pull requests is a pair that changes together: merge both.

items.note: The security review map, then the page that renders it.
avd-swarm's open-source core and its brain pair.
Verify every image optimization run, and its KB page.
Local collector spec: the owner's answers.
Drift spec v3: the owner's answers.
Both portals name the Cloud Shell prompt each command expects.
What is left of the move to the avd-ops organization.
Cloud Shell conventions and the sandbox batch method.
Code signing: the log bundle collector moved to avd-current-state.

sections.title: Read first
sections.intro: New specs the owner hasn't reviewed yet.

sections.title: Hold
sections.intro: Not for merging yet. Each says why.

items.note: Wait until its checks, including knowledge capture, pass.

items.text: Say which pull requests you merged while it was out, so each thread re-pins its readers and records its closeout.
Ask for a rebase of every line that says Merge conflict.
Confirm every sandbox run finished and nothing is billing before approving a new one.
